verdict.rationale: Statsig supports rollback-style controls (emergency disable switch, scheduled rollouts) and lets you version and select which prompt is live for AI use cases, plus CLI/CI-CD integration for managing gates and experiments as code. But there's no dedicated 'automation' object with explicit versioning/review/rollback workflow — no audit trail, approval/review process, or diff/history UI is documented, so the story is only partially covered by adjacent flag/prompt-versioning features. Missing for 10: explicit version history/audit log UI, formal review/approval workflow for changes, and a true 'automation' concept (vs. flags/experiments/prompts) with rollback semantics.
